name: Return To The Henge
body:
School conjuration (teleportation); Level: jester 3

CASTING

Casting Time: 1 move action
Components: (not included in source material)

EFFECT

Range: personal
Target: you
Duration: instantaneous

DESCRIPTION

You teleport 15 feet. This is follows the same rules as a dimension door spell, but without the need for a verbal component and with a much shorter range.

In addition, you heal 2d8 points of damage +1 point per caster level (maximum +10) (as per cure moderate wounds).
